rules: Names, ranks, service identifiers, units, dates, times, years, places, case facts, decisions and copy counts are variables, never inherited from the historical case.
Institution labels are fixed for this configured model; another institution requires its own explicitly configured template version.
Service identifiers are explicit user data, not the removed generated person reference-number system.
Testimony is inserted as reviewed source text without rewriting it to imitate the sample case.
No fixed denial of previous convictions, family status, oath, attestation, signature, conclusion or responsibility is assumed.
The blank working form can display unfilled clause patterns. Completed output must omit unconfirmed factual clauses and report the omission in its review interface.

This is a document-format prototype, not a deployed review or signing workflow. Confirmation booleans here belong to fictional fixtures only; production confirmations must be authenticated server-owned events.
